questions.prompt: Iris speaks in clipped sentences and ends with "I guess" when she's actually sure. Which line sounds most like Iris?

options.label: I would love to talk about that all afternoon.
What a profound and meaningful question.

questions.mentorPostScript: Voice register is the rhythm a character keeps even when the topic changes.

questions.prompt: Cal tries too hard to be casual. He uses "so" as a stall. Which line is Cal's?

options.label: I formally object to this premise.
Tell me everything you've ever felt about geese.

questions.mentorPostScript: Filler words are part of voice. They carry the feeling.

questions.prompt: A character who speaks in short questions might say:

options.label: I will now deliver a long monologue about my feelings.
I find your behavior to be inexplicable.

questions.mentorPostScript: Short questions feel like the character is testing the air.
